sentences.text: The parties i.e. the applicant and the respondent No.2 have settled the dispute amicably.
The terms of the settlement arrived at between the parties are placed on record.
It is marked 'X' for the purpose of identification.
They have agreed to severe the matrimonial ties amicably and she has consented for quashement of the crime.
3. Since the offence was registered pursuant to the matrimonial discord and the couple now having decided to settled the dispute, in our view it is not contrary to any public policy.
4. The application is allowed.

The Crime No.0250/2021 registered with the Police Station,
Vazirabad for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and the consequent charge sheet No.252/2021 and the criminal case bearing RCC No.1007/2021
are quashed and set aside.
